purpose: Teach: 口語/前衛/性欲/優勢/伯爵/健常/皇位/綱領

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の口語コミュニケーションを尊重しろ
lines.en: I want our company to respect how our staff actually speak to each other.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Slight weight on 「尊重しろ」 — not harsh, but expecting compliance. The tone of someone used to being listened to. No flourish.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。前衛的なデザインの新商品を企画します
lines.en: Understood. I'll develop a new product line with forward-thinking design.
lines.style: Clipped, professional affirmation. The 「はい」 lands quick and clean. Steady pace on the plan — demonstrating he's already thinking ahead. Competent, not eager.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の性欲偏見はハラスメントだと教育しろ
lines.en: Make sure staff understand that gender bias in the workplace is harassment.
lines.style: Firm but not cold. Slight pause before the directive — he's chosen his words deliberately. The instruction lands with quiet seriousness. No room for misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、市場で優勢な位置を確保します
lines.en: Got it. We'll work to secure our competitive position in the market.
lines.style: Quick, decisive acknowledgment. Steady forward momentum on the second sentence — he's keeping pace with Hiroshi's expectations. Professional, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、創業家伯爵家の伝統を尊重しろ
lines.en: And respect the founding family's heritage in everything we do.
lines.style: Measured. The second directive of a series — steady but not repetitive. Slightly more reflective than the previous lines, as if this one matters differently. Still commanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の健常な就労環境を整備します
lines.en: Absolutely. I'll ensure we maintain a healthy, inclusive work environment.
lines.style: Affirming again, but with slightly more warmth than before — he's tracking Hiroshi's full intent now. Not rushed. Confident in the commitment. Still professional.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、皇位継承式典のスポンサーも検討しろ
lines.en: And explore sponsoring the imperial succession ceremony as well.
lines.style: Final directive of the briefing. Slightly longer breath — this is a bigger-picture item. Still measured, still commanding, but with a touch of vision behind it. No urgency, just expectation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営綱領を社員に再周知します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure the company's management principles are communicated again to all staff.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slightly more weight than the previous 「はい」 lines — this one closes the meeting. Steady, competent, and settled. The promise of action.
